host lab-spd  QEMU lab-spd  SPD not read: SPD driver did not bind
 The driver spd5118 is loaded and did not bind 0-0050, 0-0051. On DDR5 the driver has to write the
 page register of the hub, and a controller set to block writes to the SPD addresses refuses that. A
 scan as root reads the setting.
 SMBIOS lists 4 slots.
 Search the kernel log for spd5118.
